Beijing北京

Diplomatic, educational, and administratively the most cautious.

Median asking
¥60k–120k/m²
Gross yield
1.5%–2.0%
Purchase cap
One self-use home
Land term
70 years, residential

Beijing concentrates embassies, state-owned enterprise headquarters, the country's best universities and the largest diplomatic community in China. Foreign residential demand follows that map: Chaoyang for the diplomatic and business core, Shunyi for compounds and international schools, Haidian for families anchored to education.

Administration here is thorough. Expect document checks to be literal, timelines to be longer, and the housing authority to apply the one-home rule without much discretion.

Can a foreigner buy here?

One self-use home. At least one year of work or study in Beijing, purchase within Beijing, valid residence permit, and proof of employment or enrolment. Married applicants must declare the spouse's property holdings in China.

Villa compounds in Shunyi and Chaoyang, and mid-rise apartments near the Third Ring, account for most foreign purchases.

Before you view anything here

The paragraph above is a summary, not an answer. City practice is applied at district level and changes without much notice.

Take it to the counter: ask the district housing bureau to confirm your eligibility in writing, using the script in how to verify.

How to check it

Where to live

Districts that work for foreign buyers

Not every district is workable at every stage. These are the ones with the schools, services and resale liquidity foreigners actually need.

Chaoyang朝阳

CBD, Sanlitun, Liangmaqiao. Where most foreign residents actually live and socialise.

Shunyi顺义

Villa territory. International schools, larger plots, car-dependent, close to the airport.

Haidian海淀

Universities and the strongest school district in the country. Premium pricing follows catchment.

Dongcheng & Xicheng东城 / 西城

The historic core. Scarce stock, strict controls, courtyard houses with heritage constraints.

Yizhuang亦庄

New economic zone in the south-east; newer stock, better value, thinner services for foreigners.

The market

How Beijing actually trades

Resale apartments near the ring roads are the workable middle. Courtyard houses (四合院) are a specialist purchase with title and heritage complications that most buyers underestimate.

Living here

Settling in

Excellent hospitals and schools, brutal traffic, and long distances between the places you will actually spend time. Choose the neighbourhood around your commute and school run before you choose the apartment.

Know before you offer

Three risks in this market

  • School catchment (学区) premiums are volatile and policy-driven.
  • Heating, insulation and building age vary enormously between 1990s and 2010s stock.
  • Some compounds restrict foreign ownership at the building or management level — always check before signing.

Best suited to

Families anchored to education and institutions, and buyers who value a deep professional services market.
